channel.description: Kubernetes from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Scheduler Preemption for In-Place Pod Resize (Alpha)
item.description: In Kubernetes, resource allocation has historically been a static decision made during a Pod's initial scheduling and placement. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Presentation: How To Run on Three Clouds at Once, and When Not To
item.description: Ross McFarlane and Kevin Holditch discuss Form3's evolution from a single-cloud setup to a triple active multi-cloud architecture. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: A secure software factory on Incus, not on Kubernetes
Kubernetes v1.37: Introducing Node Lifecycle Conditions
item.description: Kubernetes has many ways to describe what is happening on a Node. Readiness, taints, Pod state, labels, annotations, and provider-specific APIs each expose part of the picture. (1 source: kubernetesblog)
